content.short: Cabin DAO is a community of creators and remote web3 builders using blockchain to earn a living online.
content.description: Cabin DAO is an online and in-person community that uses blockchain technology to help creators earn a living online. Its core presence centers on Discord, with updates shared publicly on Twitter. A key idea behind Cabin DAO is the concept of decentralized cities: a network of distinct physical locations connected by shared governance and culture, as described by Jon Hillis in Tech Stack for Decentralized Cities. This approach blends online and offline community organizing with a shared governance framework.
content.meta: Cabin DAO unites creators and remote web3 builders using blockchain to earn a living online. Discover Cabin DAO and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
